note: The Turks and Caicos Islands Financial Services Commission's schedule of domestic banks' rates and charges as at June 2026: the minimum monthly service charge on a personal current account at CIBC Caribbean and on Scotiabank's Total Access Account. RBC's charge ranges by account type without naming them, so it isn't written; per-item charges aren't modelled.

sources.title: Turks and Caicos Islands Financial Services Commission, Schedule of Domestic Banks' Rates and Charges as at June 2026
sources.said: Schedule of Domestic Banks' Rates and Charges as at June 2026 ... 1.0 CURRENT ACCOUNTS ... 1.1 Minimum monthly service charge 0.50% per annum $12.25 $10.00 $5.00 to $48.00 depending on the account type ... $14.00 - Total Access Account
